data.title: Marina Life Residences
data.about:
Marina Life Residences at Dubai Islands is a new luxury development by Tarrad Development Properties. This exclusive project features 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, offering stunning ocean views and modern, low-rise architecture. Residents can enjoy the serenity of waterfront living with world-class amenities and seamless access to Dubai's vibrant lifestyle.

Located within Dubai Islands development, Marina Life offers a peaceful escape, surrounded by high-end hotels, resorts, and beach attractions. The waterfront apartments boast elegant designs, large balconies, and floor-to-ceiling windows that highlight the natural beauty of the Arabian Gulf.

With facilities like an infinity pool, zen gardens, and a state-of-the-art fitness center, Marina Life by Dubai Islands promises a resort-style living experience. Whether you're seeking relaxation or adventure, your dream home at Marina Life awaits, providing a perfect balance of comfort and luxury for all ages.

characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: Exclusive waterfront living at Dubai Islands by Saeed Tarrad Development with stunning Gulf views
  • Luxurious Apartments: Offering 1 to 4bedroom apartments with modern architecture and high-end finishes
  • Flexible Payment Plan: 15% down payment, 60/40 plan with handover by Q4 2027
  • Resort-like Amenities: Infinity pool, gym, kids’ play areas, and more for a family-friendly environment
  • State-of-the-art fitness center, infinity pool, and zen gardens for relaxation and wellness
  • Spacious open-plan layouts with high-end finishes, floor-to-ceiling windows, and large balconies
  • Seamless Connectivity: Close to major attractions like Marina and Canal Walk, with easy city access

image.name: Marina Life Residences at Dubai Islands

location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Marina Life Residences at Dubai Islands, developed by Saeed Tarrad Development, offers a luxurious waterfront lifestyle. Located off the coast of Deira, this prime destination provides exclusive access to pristine beaches and premium leisure attractions. With easy access to Marina and Canal Walk, residents can enjoy vibrant nightlife and world-class amenities. This Dubai Islands development perfectly balances coastal tranquility with the city's excitement, making it the ideal dream home at Marina Life.

  • 14 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
  • 22 Minutes to The Dubai Frame
  • 24 Minutes to Dubai World Trade Centre
  • 24 Minutes to Downtown Dubai
  • 33 Minutes to Business Bay
